release_notes: Fix optional room player limits: save a known maximum while leaving minimum unknown, or vice versa. Partial ranges retain the known bound and confirm only the current group size; changed groups need renewed approval. Keep grouped-copy matching titles with room limits, approvals and own-platform confirmations. Known limits, ownership, platform rules and vetoes remain enforced. Includes updated instructions and troubleshooting. Same seven capabilities and manual updates; requires host Plugin API v1.1.12 and Discord Bot Notifications >=0.1.2.
